sensor_layout: M26 Fibonacci directions mapped to analytic scalp then radially to each discrete scalp; projection error retained
scale_policy: one finest-baseline candidate-grid spectral scale per head, fixed for all cases
orientation: free Cartesian; MRI RAS metres; outward stored faces, explicit inward OpenMEEG adapter
solver: OpenMEEG 2.6.0 symmetric BEM, direct general geometry API, all four layers
linear_solver: SciPy pivoted LU on OpenMEEG symmetric assembly, with residual and algebraic reciprocity checks

reference_hierarchy.A: exact homogeneous central-dipole sphere plus MNE semi-analytical heterogeneous sphere
reference_hierarchy.B: whole-model mesh convergence including recorded sensor discretization
reference_hierarchy.C: MNE linear-collocation versus OpenMEEG symmetric BEM on matched three-layer controls only; full four-layer independence NOT_ESTABLISHED

resampling: fixed-family stratified head bootstrap then sources within head; average paired noise; same resamples for contrasts
missing_policy: retain every planned head/case/source/method failure; incomplete aggregate never imputed
ordinary_CI: small reference and adversarial tests only; no full ensemble
generator_equation: axis jitter sampled first; a=warp_xz*(-1)^head, b=warp_y3*(-1)^head; CSF/skull centers independently normal; scalp/brain centered; bump direction drawn after centers
sphere_control: new M27 MNE four-shell sphere at original radii/physical units, same 35/55 mm grid, per-head source/moment/noise draws and M26 sensor directions; not historical measurements
